name: Databox
description: Connect Databox to your conversations and get instant answers about your business performance. Query metrics, explore trends, and analyze data from 100+ connected sources - all in plain language, no dashboard switching required. Make Databox a native part of your workflow - an always-on data layer that turns performance questions into clear, actionable answers.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Databox to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Databox to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.databox.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Databox MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Databox lists 17 MCP tools, including ask_genie, create_data_source, create_dataset, delete_data_source, delete_dataset, get_current_datetime, get_databoard_by_id, get_dataset_ingestions, get_ingestion, ingest_data, list_accounts, and list_data_source_datasets.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Databox?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Databox in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Databox requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Databox is developed by Databox. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
